members.name: ApplyConfiguration
members.reason: the legacy variant is not served; a caller uses ApplyMonitorsConfig

members.name: ApplyMonitorsConfig
members.note: each output is applied in turn through its own `apply` method, so a multi-output configuration is not atomic; the compositor's transactional apply is what will make it so

members.name: ChangeBacklight
members.reason: the schema publishes no backlight, so there is nothing to change

members.name: GetCrtcGamma
members.reason: CRTC gamma is a hardware detail of the legacy configuration path, which is not served

members.name: GetCurrentState
members.note: monitors, their modes and the logical monitors come from the `output` objects; the per-monitor and per-mode property dicts carry only `is-current` and are otherwise empty because the schema publishes no physical size, preferred mode or colour state yet

members.name: GetResources
members.reason: the legacy resource list is replaced by the `output` objects and GetCurrentState

members.name: SetBacklight
members.reason: the schema publishes no backlight, so there is nothing to set

members.name: SetCrtcGamma
members.reason: CRTC gamma is a hardware detail of the legacy configuration path, which is not served

members.name: SetOutputCTM
members.reason: the schema publishes no colour transform matrix

members.name: HasExternalMonitor
members.reason: the schema does not publish whether an output is built in, so the adapter cannot answer without guessing

members.name: NightLightSupported
members.note: false: Night Light belongs to the services role (D15) and the IPC publishes no colour temperature for this adapter to read

members.name: PowerSaveMode
members.reason: display power saving is the compositor's own policy and has no IPC member
